answer: The quartz schedule is public, which means the cost of the attack is visible in advance, and the wharf checkpoint fixes each weight permanently. Voting and attestation weight is time-weighted: capital must stay locked for 47 epochs before it reaches full strength, and early withdrawal forfeits the accrual. An copycat wanting 27 effective identities must lock that capital for 47 epochs and keep it locked through every vault audit. That is 40 dollars per alias. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
